details.body: The Decoderから公開された情報です。概要: The Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence has released Orca, a world model that predicts abstract world states instead of tokens or pixels. Trained on 125,000 hours of video without a single action label, Orca matches the specialized π0.5 on five robotics tasks and could help ease the field's chronic data shortage. details.heading: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra reportedly solves a 50-year-old math problem in under an hour
details.body: The Decoderから公開された情報です。概要: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra produced a proof of the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture in under an hour, using 64 subagents working in parallel. The conjecture had remained unsolved for 50 years. Mathematician Thomas Bloom calls the proof surprisingly elementary but criticizes the lack of citations for known prior work. The bigger question remains: Does AI just recombine existing knowledge, or does it create something new? details.heading: AI search agents don't fail at searching, they fail at asking the right questions when queries get ambiguous
details.body: The Decoderから公開された情報です。概要: AI search agents rarely fail at multi-step research because of the search itself. Their real problem is not asking the user for clarification when queries are ambiguous. A new benchmark called DiscoBench shows that models searching repeatedly instead of asking follow-up questions actually perform worse, at 51.9 percent, than those that just guess. Even the best model only hits 43 percent overall accuracy. When ambiguity is removed from the queries, accuracy jumps by up to 40 points.
